```{r descriptive_statistics}
# Import the data
ships <- read.csv(
  "ShipAccidents.csv",
  na.strings = "NA"
)

# Create one construction-era variable
ships$construction_era <- with(
  ships,
  ifelse(
    construction1 == 1, "Construction 1",
    ifelse(
      construction2 == 1, "Construction 2",
      ifelse(
        construction3 == 1, "Construction 3",
        "Reference"
      )
    )
  )
)

# Convert categorical variables to factors
ships$construction_era <- factor(
  ships$construction_era,
  levels = c(
    "Reference",
    "Construction 1",
    "Construction 2",
    "Construction 3"
  )
)

ships$operational <- factor(ships$operational)

# Retain observations with nonmissing exposure
ships_analysis <- subset(
  ships,
  !is.na(exposure)
)

# Check dimensions and missing values
dim(ships)
colSums(is.na(ships))
nrow(ships_analysis)

# Select variables for descriptive statistics
variables <- ships_analysis[
  c("accidents", "exposure", "service_months")
]

# Calculate descriptive statistics
descriptive_table <- data.frame(
  Variable = names(variables),
  Mean = sapply(variables, mean),
  SD = sapply(variables, sd),
  Median = sapply(variables, median),
  Minimum = sapply(variables, min),
  Maximum = sapply(variables, max),
  row.names = NULL
)

# Round only the numeric columns
descriptive_table[-1] <- round(
  descriptive_table[-1],
  2
)

# Display the table
descriptive_table
```


```{r accident_occurrence}
# Import the data
ships <- read.csv(
  "ShipAccidents.csv",
  na.strings = "NA"
)

# Create construction-era variable
ships$construction_era <- with(
  ships,
  ifelse(construction1 == 1, "Construction 1",
  ifelse(construction2 == 1, "Construction 2",
  ifelse(construction3 == 1, "Construction 3",
                             "Reference")))
)

ships$construction_era <- factor(
  ships$construction_era,
  levels = c(
    "Reference",
    "Construction 1",
    "Construction 2",
    "Construction 3"
  )
)

# Convert operational status to a factor
ships$operational <- factor(
  ships$operational,
  levels = c(0, 1),
  labels = c("Category 0", "Category 1")
)

# Construct the binary outcome
# 1 = at least one accident; 0 = no accidents
ships$accident_event <- ifelse(ships$accidents > 0, 1, 0)

ships$accident_status <- factor(
  ships$accident_event,
  levels = c(0, 1),
  labels = c("No accidents", "At least one accident")
)

# Examine sample size and missing values
dim(ships)
colSums(is.na(ships))

# Retain observations with complete information
ships_analysis <- subset(
  ships,
  !is.na(exposure) &
  !is.na(operational) &
  !is.na(construction_era)
)

nrow(ships_analysis)

# Frequency and proportion of binary outcome
outcome_frequency <- table(ships_analysis$accident_status)
outcome_frequency
round(prop.table(outcome_frequency) * 100, 1)

# Descriptive statistics for exposure
exposure_statistics <- data.frame(
  Mean = mean(ships_analysis$exposure),
  SD = sd(ships_analysis$exposure),
  Median = median(ships_analysis$exposure),
  Minimum = min(ships_analysis$exposure),
  Maximum = max(ships_analysis$exposure)
)

round(exposure_statistics, 2)

# Outcome by operational status
operational_table <- table(
  ships_analysis$operational,
  ships_analysis$accident_status
)

operational_table
round(prop.table(operational_table, margin = 1) * 100, 1)

# Outcome by construction era
construction_table <- table(
  ships_analysis$construction_era,
  ships_analysis$accident_status
)

construction_table
round(prop.table(construction_table, margin = 1) * 100, 1)

# Boxplot of exposure by accident outcome
boxplot(
  exposure ~ accident_status,
  data = ships_analysis,
  xlab = "Accident Outcome",
  ylab = "Exposure",
  main = "Exposure by Accident Outcome",
  col = c("lightgray", "lightblue")
)

# Proportion with at least one accident by operational status
operational_proportion <- prop.table(
  operational_table,
  margin = 1
)[, "At least one accident"]

barplot(
  operational_proportion,
  ylim = c(0, 1),
  ylab = "Proportion with at Least One Accident",
  xlab = "Operational Status",
  main = "Accident Occurrence by Operational Status",
  col = "steelblue"
)

# Proportion with at least one accident by construction era
construction_proportion <- prop.table(
  construction_table,
  margin = 1
)[, "At least one accident"]

barplot(
  construction_proportion,
  ylim = c(0, 1),
  ylab = "Proportion with at Least One Accident",
  xlab = "Construction Era",
  main = "Accident Occurrence by Construction Era",
  col = "darkseagreen",
  las = 2
)
```
